messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up  we need a short daily follow-up plan for social engagement post-launch (first 72h). Goal: convert CTRs into webinar signups and capture hot leads. Thinking: 1) daily pinned reply with webinar link, 2) 2 follow-up tweets highlighting demo clips, 3) 1 LinkedIn comment thread to surface poll results. Volunteers?

Evan Brooks: I'll monitor comments and surface high-volume threads. I'll reply with product-focused answers and the webinar link where appropriate. Also recommend using templated replies to save time.

Diego Rivera: I'll run the paid retargeting creative for the 7-day window and swap creatives if CTR < 0.8% after 24h. Also will escalate to creative ops if performance flatlines.

Samir Patel: I'll prepare 6 canned replies: demo clip, technical blog, case study, pricing, trial link, webinar. Each reply will include a short UTM. We'll add a note to personalize if the commenter mentions specific infra/hardware.

marketing-bot: Webinar registrants: 412 (so far). High-intent leads (company_size >=500) flagged: 34.

Priya Nair: Nice early signal. How do we surface hot leads to the SDRs mid-launch? I want a midday digest at 2pm PT listing top 10 hot leads and top 5 influencer referrals. Connor (ops) can you automate?

Samir Patel: We have a Slack digest webhook that can post a CSV summary. I'll set the filter for conversion events: webinar_reg with interest_level >=8 or demo_requested = true.

Diego Rivera: Also recommend a creative refresh on day 2 with the poll results graphic and a short quote from an early beta customer. That tends to boost trust and CTR.

Evan Brooks: Agree. I'll capture any customer quotes and tag them. Also will escalate any negative comments to product.

marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish day-1 pinned reply with webinar link 1 hour after launch.

Priya Nair: Great. Final operational note: keep the 60/40 A/B split notes visible in the planner and make sure Buffer has the right UTM tags. We'll reconvene at 9am launch day for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
